# Get all files in the directory
files = apis.file_system.show_directory(access_token=fs_token, directory_path='~/documents/work/meetings_files/', entry_type='files', recursive=False)

# Process each file
for file_path in files:
    # Extract filename from path
    filename = file_path.split('/')[-1]
    # Split on "__" to get date and rest
    date_part, rest = filename.split('__', 1)
    # rest is like "slides.ppt" or "video_recording.mp4"
    # Split on last dot to get file_name and extension
    if '.' in rest:
        file_name, ext = rest.rsplit('.', 1)
    else:
        file_name = rest
        ext = ''
    # New directory path
    new_dir = f"~/documents/work/meetings_files/{file_name}"
    # Create directory if not exists (recursive=True to be safe)
    apis.file_system.create_directory(access_token=fs_token, directory_path=new_dir, recursive=True)
    # New file path
    new_file = f"~/documents/work/meetings_files/{file_name}/{date_part}.{ext}"
    # Move file
    result = apis.file_system.move_file(access_token=fs_token, source_file_path=file_path, destination_file_path=new_file)
    print(f"Moved {file_path} -> {new_file}: {result}")

# Delete the empty old date directories
import re
dirs = apis.file_system.show_directory(access_token=fs_token, directory_path='~/documents/work/meetings_files/', entry_type='directories', recursive=False)
for d in dirs:
    # d is like "/home/adam/documents/work/meetings_files/2023-apr-03/"
    # Check if it matches the date pattern (e.g., 2023-apr-03)
    basename = d.rstrip('/').split('/')[-1]
    if re.match(r'^\d{4}-[a-z]{3}-\d{2}$', basename):
        print(apis.file_system.delete_directory(access_token=fs_token, directory_path=d))
